name: Widget Studio for Elementor
author: Akash Halder

sections.description:
Widget Studio for Elementor extends Elementor with beautifully coded and customizable widgets.
This plugin is ideal for developers and designers who want to build reusable Elementor blocks with extended layout and design flexibility.

Widget Lists

  1. Back to Top Button
  2. Picture Scroller
  3. Registration Form
  4. Shadow Heading
  5. Split Action Button
  6. Vertical Timeline

More widgets are coming soon!

Credits

  • Based on Elementor Page Builder by Elementor Ltd.
  • Icon support via Elementor Icons Manager

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Elementor > Widgets to find the “Widget Studio” section.
  4. Drag & drop your desired widget into your page design.
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor Pro?

No, it works with the free version of Elementor.

Can I use this with any theme?

Yes. It’s built to work with any well-coded WordPress theme.
